title: 潛盾發進與到達端止水
titleEn: Water sealing at shield launch and reception
summary: 本課聚焦以始發到達介面、地層水文和暫態受力驗證止水轉換。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on verify launch and reception sealing transitions through interfaces, hydrogeology and temporary load paths. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「始發到達控制體」與「水頭基準與外水力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Launch and reception control volumes" and "Head datum and external water force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 始發到達控制體：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Launch and reception control volumes: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「始發到達控制體」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Launch and reception control volumes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穿越井壁時，機器、井體和地層之間的支護與止水邊界會改變，不能只檢查最終貫通狀態。應按位置畫出每個階段仍存在的屏障和力流，特別辨識暫時只剩單一道防護的區間。 假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。 屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「始發到達控制體」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crossing a shaft wall changes support and sealing boundaries among machine, shaft and ground. Checking only final breakthrough misses transitions; map barriers and load paths by position, identifying intervals with only one remaining barrier. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition. A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Launch and reception control volumes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「始發到達控制體」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Launch and reception control volumes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「始發到達控制體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Launch and reception control volumes" is correct?
options: 最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。
穿越井壁時，機器、井體和地層之間的支護與止水邊界會改變，不能只檢查最終貫通狀態。
井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。
optionsEn: Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions.
Crossing a shaft wall changes support and sealing boundaries among machine, shaft and ground.
Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.
quiz.explanation: 穿越井壁時，機器、井體和地層之間的支護與止水邊界會改變，不能只檢查最終貫通狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Crossing a shaft wall changes support and sealing boundaries among machine, shaft and ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 始發到達控制體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Launch and reception control volumes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「始發到達控制體」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Launch and reception control volumes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 始發到達控制體：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Launch and reception control volumes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「始發到達控制體」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Launch and reception control volumes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄始發到達控制體的資料來源與適用條件。用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for launch and reception control volumes. Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。
knowledge.textEn: Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄始發到達控制體的資料來源與適用條件。用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。

Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「始發到達控制體」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Launch and reception control volumes"?
options: 用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
井內沒有看見漏水就證明地層不可能向其他空間流失。
optionsEn: Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
No visible shaft leakage proves that ground cannot be flowing into other spaces.
quiz.explanation: 用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 始發到達控制體：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Launch and reception control volumes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「始發到達控制體」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Launch and reception control volumes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。

井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。

A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design.
Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.

quiz.explanationEn: A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水頭基準與外水力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Head datum and external water force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水頭基準與外水力」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head datum and external water force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。壓力計高程與測段連通性需清楚，不能把井深或某個遠處水位直接當成所有位置的水頭。 假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。 把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭基準與外水力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ. Gauge elevation and interval connectivity matter; neither shaft depth nor one distant water level represents every location. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation. Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head datum and external water force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水頭基準與外水力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Head datum and external water force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水頭基準與外水力
knowledge.titleEn: Head datum and external water force
knowledge.text: 井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。壓力計高程與測段連通性需清楚，不能把井深或某個遠處水位直接當成所有位置的水頭。
knowledge.textEn: The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ. Gauge elevation and interval connectivity matter; neither shaft depth nor one distant water level represents every location.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭基準與外水力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head datum and external water force" is correct?
options: 井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。
少數高強度處理體試件可以排除所有貫通薄弱通道。
井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。
optionsEn: Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.
A few strong treated-ground specimens exclude every connected weak pathway.
The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ.
quiz.explanation: 井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水頭基準與外水力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head datum and external water force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭基準與外水力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Head datum and external water force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build head ranges from multilevel observations with a common elevation datum and pumping timeline; geotechnical and structural engineers confirm adverse water conditions and uniform-load assumptions rather than treating the example as a test pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水頭基準與外水力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Head datum and external water force", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。
總反力除支點數就是每個實際支點的真實受力。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity.
Total reaction divided by support count equals the actual force at every support.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水頭基準與外水力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head datum and external water force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭基準與外水力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head datum and external water force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build head ranges from multilevel observations with a common elevation datum and pumping timeline; geotechnical and structural engineers confirm adverse water conditions and uniform-load assumptions rather than treating the example as a test pressure. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄水頭基準與外水力的資料來源與適用條件。用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for head datum and external water force. Build head ranges from multilevel observations with a common elevation datum and pumping timeline; geotechnical and structural engineers confirm adverse water conditions and uniform-load assumptions rather than treating the example as a test pressure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。
knowledge.textEn: Build head ranges from multilevel observations with a common elevation datum and pumping timeline; geotechnical and structural engineers confirm adverse water conditions and uniform-load assumptions rather than treating the example as a test pressure. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄水頭基準與外水力的資料來源與適用條件。用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for head datum and external water force. Build head ranges from multilevel observations with a common elevation datum and pumping timeline; geotechnical and structural engineers confirm adverse water conditions and uniform-load assumptions rather than treating the example as a test pressure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭基準與外水力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head datum and external water force"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。
資料傳輸延遲就是地層可以安全等待處置的時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Build head ranges from multilevel observations with a common elevation datum and pumping timeline.
Data transmission latency is the time the ground can safely wait for intervention.
quiz.explanation: 用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build head ranges from multilevel observations with a common elevation datum and pumping timeline; geotechnical and structural engineers confirm adverse water conditions and uniform-load assumptions rather than treating the example as a test pressure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水頭基準與外水力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head datum and external water force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭基準與外水力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Head datum and external water force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水頭基準與外水力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head datum and external water force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
少數高強度處理體試件可以排除所有貫通薄弱通道。
把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A few strong treated-ground specimens exclude every connected weak pathway.
Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load.
quiz.explanation: 把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
